description.value: The study investigated hippocampal and amygdalar gray matter volume and structural covariance alterations in coal mine gas explosion-related PTSD.

description.value: T1-weighted structural MR images were processed in SPM8: segmented into gray matter, white matter, and cerebrospinal fluid; gray-matter images were normalized to MNI space at 1.5 mm isotropic resolution using DARTEL; modulated GMV maps were generated by multiplying gray-matter concentration by nonlinear normalization determinants and smoothed with an 8 mm FWHM kernel for hippocampal volume and structural covariance analyses.
